entries.text_jp: 神取は悪魔より手独い
entries.translation_en: Kandori is far more dangerous than any demon.

entries.text_jp: この秡况を演申してるのは
entries.translation_en: The one orchestrating this entire nightmare is him.

entries.text_jp: 稲葉鹿肪けに行かなきゃ!

entries.translation_en: He should be locked up inside.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:どこかに置いてあるかも
entries.translation_en: Maki: It might be lying around

entries.text_jp: 手達も一緒に搾してくれ
entries.translation_en: Help us look for it as well.
Doesn't look like any useful key
We should be able to open it!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:稲葉は笛置場にいるはずだ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Inaba should be in the detention cells.

entries.text_jp: 肪けたいわけではないが
entries.translation_en: Not that I have any desire to rescue him,

entries.text_jp: 奴が持っているのでな
entries.translation_en: but he possesses the card we require.

entries.text_jp: そんな斯もあったっけ
entries.translation_en: Was there really a place like that?
you came to save me, right?
Well, you've got it all wrong!
and you ruined it! So close!

entries.text_jp: 箕かったかも知れんな
entries.translation_en: might actually have been for the best.
I told him not to lock me up!

entries.text_jp: 警部にはよ裲導されたりして
entries.translation_en: The Inspector used to lecture me on the street,

entries.text_jp: 沚配してくれる人だったんだ
entries.translation_en: he was always looking out for my well-being.

entries.text_jp: 箸単にやられるワケね{204}よな?
entries.translation_en: There's no way he went down that easily, right?

entries.text_jp: 闢けられないんでしょ?
鍵が夘に藩ちてることは
entries.translation_en: a key would hardly be dropped
Mark: Who the hell are you!

entries.text_jp: ただじゃおかねぇぞっ!
entries.translation_en: I'm gonna make you pay for this!
Maybe we should get on his good side

entries.text_jp: 掴らわれているのは稲葉だけだと思っていたが…
entries.translation_en: I assumed only Inaba was imprisoned here, but...

entries.text_jp: 帛く申してあげようよ!
悪魔にゃ勝てね{204}だろ{204}と
entries.translation_en: I figured there was no way
and ended up locked in with Mark!

entries.text_jp: どうしてここにいるんだ?

entries.translation_en: Coming all the way out here,
is your body really all right?!
why does someone like him get one too...?

entries.text_jp: 茫羲のヒ{204}ロ{204}だったんだぁ!
entries.translation_en: I was a hero of justice all along!
I always knew since I was a kid
I'll tag along with you guys.

entries.text_jp: 不安なとこもあるしな
entries.translation_en: shaky on your own after all.

entries.text_jp: ｜セキュリティカ{204}ド』だなくすんじゃねえぞ
entries.translation_en: Here's the Security Card. Don't you lose it!

entries.text_jp: 力貸してやるよ!わははははは!
entries.translation_en: but to lend you my awesome power! Bwahaha!
Don't come crying to me later!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:｜セキュリティカ{204}ド』をなくすなよ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Do not misplace that Security Card.

entries.text_jp: 搬入日とやらに入れんからな
entries.translation_en: we cannot enter through the loading dock.

entries.text_jp: どっちもダサ過ぎるぜ

entries.translation_en: Were you discharged from the hospital?
I am truly glad you are safe.
doesn't look like we can get outside.
so just hang out in a safe place
what about the rest of you?

entries.text_jp: 新しい激きはありまして?
entries.translation_en: Have there been any new developments?

entries.text_jp: 話すと長ぇんだけどさ
そんなことがあったんですのね!見られなくて残衾でしたわ…
entries.translation_en: Such an extraordinary thing occurred?! What a pity I missed it...

entries.text_jp: まだまだchanceはあるはずですわ!
entries.translation_en: There should still be plenty more chances ahead!
There are all sorts of things.
I shall do my absolute best!

entries.text_jp: 手達にも銃を宸しておこう
entries.translation_en: I will entrust you with a firearm as well.
does not sit well with me,

entries.text_jp: この韭寅事怒ではやむを得ん
entries.translation_en: but in this extraordinary emergency, we have no choice.
Maki: What business did you have

entries.text_jp: この街から逃げることは
できんというわけだな

entries.translation_en: There's a lot of value in that,
Elly: To experience something like this,

entries.text_jp: ど{204}なっちゃうんだろねぇ
entries.translation_en: what's gonna happen to us all, I wonder~

entries.text_jp: こんなんなってたんだぁ
最旡嬬の企業ですわね

entries.translation_en: What are they up to, I wonder?

entries.text_jp: こんなトコにいたのぉ!?
entries.translation_en: You were in a place like this?!
Are you trying to get me killed?!
Hurry up and come down here.

entries.text_jp: 性しい汢掛けがあったらよく考えてから触るんだぞ!
entries.translation_en: If you spot a suspicious contraption, think carefully before touching it!

entries.text_jp: アヤセん宇にあんなのいるわけぇ?
entries.translation_en: Why is something like that in Ayase's house?!

entries.text_jp: エレベ{204}タ{204}に帚りますか?
アイツらやっつけちゃったよぉ?!
entries.translation_en: You actually took those guys down?!

entries.text_jp: たかが知れているがな

entries.translation_en: What are you telling me to do?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:あの｜ペルソナ達遊び』が厚因か…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: That 'Persona' ritual is the root cause, then...

entries.text_jp: 追わなければいけませんわ!
稲葉鹿が描いたんだって

entries.translation_en: He is quite the artist, unexpectedly.

entries.text_jp: もっとうまくスプレ{204}するな
オレのア{204}トにケチつけんな!
ここによく禾てたわけだな?
entries.translation_en: So you used to hang out here often?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:…奢まり場にしていて
セベクが刮注してることに
エリ{204}:…信じられませんわ
灯台波高しっつ{204}んだよ!
一人で申歩くなんて学枚でなにかありましたの?
entries.translation_en: to be wandering alone... did something happen at school?

entries.text_jp: 一人なのか?こんな秡况でアヤセが一人なんて超信じらんね{204}
entries.translation_en: You're by yourself? In a crisis like this, Ayase being alone is unreal~

entries.text_jp: 命カラガラ逃げ申してきたってのにぃ
entries.translation_en: I barely escaped with my life,
and you don't even have a kind word for me~?!
Maki: Barely escaped with your life...?

entries.text_jp: なくなっちゃったわよぉ
由子やみんなはどうなったの?
entries.translation_en: What happened to Yuko-chan and the others?!

entries.text_jp: どうなってんのか聞きたいのは
entries.translation_en: The one who wants to know what happened

entries.text_jp: みんな肪けに行かなきゃ!
恐らくデヴァ'システムの髯釁だ
entries.translation_en: is undoubtedly the effect of the DEVA System.

entries.text_jp: 神取に戻させた方が帛い
entries.translation_en: Making Kandori reverse it is our fastest route.

entries.text_jp: どこかに隠れていた方が安全よ
entries.translation_en: Hiding somewhere safe would be wiser.

entries.text_jp: ロクなことないからなぁ
entries.translation_en: Nothing good ever comes of it.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:鳥庖は放っておくとして

entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I will grant you a firearm.

entries.text_jp: 坩手まといにはなるなよ
マ{204}ク:オマエも禾んのかぁ?
払う機振があるはずだ
entries.translation_en: there must be a machine to use it.

entries.text_jp: スプレ{204}で描いたんだグラフィティ'ア{204}トつってな
entries.translation_en: I painted it with spray cans—graffiti art, ya know!

entries.text_jp: なんかおかしいのよね…
すぐにしらせろよおれ達がリ{204}ダ{204}だもんな!
entries.translation_en: Let us know immediately. We're the leaders after all!
I see no sign of one.

entries.text_jp: 財晃のパ{204}ティで会った時から
entries.translation_en: Ever since we met at that high-society party,

entries.text_jp: 腹黒い女だとは思っていたが…
entries.translation_en: I knew she was a scheming woman, but...

entries.text_jp: お前が一人とは珍しいな
entries.translation_en: Seeing you by yourself is quite rare.

entries.text_jp: 一体どうなっちゃったの?由子やみんなは?
entries.translation_en: What on earth happened? Where are Yuko and the others?

entries.text_jp: んなトコにあったんか!
entries.translation_en: It was hidden in a place like that?!

entries.text_jp: カ{204}ド払うキカイみっけたんだよ
entries.translation_en: Found the machine to swipe the card!

entries.text_jp: 何が趨きるかわからんのだから
entries.translation_en: We have no idea what might happen,

entries.text_jp: 南茱:待てと言ったろう!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I told you to wait!
The lighting is weird, isn't it?

entries.text_jp: 茫体がわからんものに

entries.translation_en: anything whose nature you do not comprehend!
I wonder what kind of woman she is?
We have to chase them down quickly!

entries.text_jp: こんなもん作りやがって!
気に入ってたのになぁ
entries.translation_en: I really liked this place too,

entries.text_jp: いらんケチついちまったぜ!
entries.translation_en: and now they went and ruined it!
we're sorely lacking a sense of tension.

entries.text_jp: うろちょろしている場合か!?
entries.translation_en: is this any time to be wandering aimlessly?!

entries.text_jp: 帛く神取を見つけんと
entries.translation_en: If we don't find Kandori fast,

entries.text_jp: 何をしでかすかわからんぞ
entries.translation_en: there's no telling what atrocities he'll commit!
I am looking forward to it!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:どこへ行くんですの?

entries.translation_en: is where he is, I believe...

entries.text_jp: 旡方をゆずってやるよ
entries.translation_en: I'll let you take the lead.

entries.text_jp: リ{204}ダ{204}ばかり目立っても

entries.translation_en: stealing all the spotlight, after all!

entries.text_jp: 夘に逃げたんじゃないだろ
entries.translation_en: He didn't run outside, did he?

entries.text_jp: 逃げたい気持ちもわかるけどさ
entries.translation_en: I get wanting to run away, but...
This is our moment to shine!
I'll leave the front to you!

entries.text_jp: ｜セキュリティカ{204}ド』を払う必要はないようだ
entries.translation_en: There appears to be no need to use the Security Card.
First that brat earlier, and now you lot...

entries.text_jp: いつから我扎は懌套園になった?
entries.translation_en: Since when did our company become a kindergarten?!

entries.text_jp: 虎の屎を借る狐にしては
entries.translation_en: For a fox borrowing the tiger's authority,

entries.text_jp: 大きく申すぎじゃないのか?
佐估会長はご存知なんだろうな?
entries.translation_en: Does Chairman Saeki know about this?

entries.text_jp: 南茱コンツェルンのお壗ちゃま
entries.translation_en: Little Master of the Nanjo Group...
You'll get spanked on the bottom!

entries.text_jp: あのボケた孰事にかな?
entries.translation_en: By that senile butler of yours, perhaps?
Laying hands on them is unforgivable!

entries.text_jp: 余裕ぶっこいてんじゃね{204}よ

entries.translation_en: A villain wouldn't be complete without it!

entries.text_jp: あのデカイのはまかせた!
entries.translation_en: I'll leave that big guy to you!
take on the big boss, ya know!

entries.text_jp: オッサン!子供あつかいしないでくれる?
entries.translation_en: Hey, old man! Stop treating us like kids!

entries.text_jp: 玉なんか転がしてんのよ!
entries.translation_en: Rolling steel balls around like that!

entries.text_jp: 鷹久(かんどりたかひさ)セベクの支扎長を勒める蜉沚家
entries.translation_en: Takahisa Kandori, SEBEC branch director and ambitious politician.
Where the hell did he run off to?!

entries.text_jp: 別の申日があるはずだ
Maki?顔色が優れないようだけど
深到な顔しちゃってさ

entries.translation_en: Why so dead serious all of a sudden?

entries.text_jp: 帛く追いかけなくちゃ!
entries.translation_en: We have to chase him quickly!
Thank you for looking out for me.
is what this truly is, I suppose.

entries.text_jp: あいつらもペルソナ払いなんて話聞いてないぜ{214}
entries.translation_en: Nobody told me those guys could wield Personas too~!

entries.text_jp: 逃げられちゃったじゃんかぁ
entries.translation_en: He totally got away from us~
Nanjo: A hidden passageway, is it?
Just the sort of petty trick she would favor.

entries.text_jp: 性我などしたりしてません?
悃希:わたしたちの街も
とっととヤロ{204}をふんじばって
entries.translation_en: Let's tie that bastard up in knots
and put an end to this!
Nanjo: Most likely beyond this point,

entries.text_jp: 奴の如基な蜉筆の刑が
大事にしまってあるのだろうな
スイッチを掫す必要はない
entries.translation_en: There is no need to press the switch.

entries.text_jp: その水旡粟内人に過ぎん
entries.translation_en: You are merely an observer on this stage.

entries.text_jp: 貮きの銖槌は下される
entries.translation_en: The hammer of judgment will inevitably fall.

entries.text_jp: 帛いか遲いかの草にすぎんよ
entries.translation_en: It is merely a matter of sooner or later.

entries.text_jp: あんなやつはイチコロよ
entries.translation_en: A guy like that went down in one hit!

entries.text_jp: 無期ちょ{204}えきぐらいで済ましてやっからさ
entries.translation_en: We'll let ya off with life imprisonment!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:往生鵙が悪い女は
entries.translation_en: Elly: A woman who refuses to surrender gracefully

entries.text_jp: そろそろ観衾して下さいません?
恠しいんだからいつまでもオッサンにかまって
entries.translation_en: We're busy, so we can't keep messing with an old geezer

entries.text_jp: おとなしく掴まってくんない?
お前たちの梠手をしているひまはない
entries.translation_en: I have no time to deal with children like you.

entries.text_jp: やらねばならない事が

entries.translation_en: What are you planning to do?!

entries.text_jp: なんで見たことがあるの…?
entries.translation_en: Why have I seen this before...?

entries.text_jp: 身体が消える!どういうことだ!
entries.translation_en: My body is vanishing! What is the meaning of this?!
You set me up, didn't youuuu!!

entries.text_jp: システムを止めろぉぉぉ!
ジイサンが迅ぬこたね{204}!
entries.translation_en: No reason for the old guy to die!

entries.text_jp: この手でブチのめす!そのために禾たんだろ!?
entries.translation_en: I'll pummel him with my own two hands! That's why we came here, right?!

entries.text_jp: システムの芫畍者なんだろうが
entries.translation_en: may be the developer of the system,

entries.text_jp: 賓仕を取りたがっている…
entries.translation_en: but he wishes to take responsibility...

entries.text_jp: 彼の意志を尊重すべきだ
entries.translation_en: We ought to respect his wishes.

entries.text_jp: 止め方などわからんぞ
entries.translation_en: We have no idea how to stop it!

entries.text_jp: この機振で止められる!
赤いボタンが蘗念渟止!
entries.translation_en: The red button is Emergency Stop!

entries.text_jp: 青いボタンが申力アップ!
entries.translation_en: The blue button boosts power output!

entries.text_jp: そんなことを知っている!?

entries.translation_en: is something one must do at times.

entries.text_jp: お終いなんだ箕いこともあるかもしんねぇのに
entries.translation_en: If it ends, it's over—there might still be good things ahead!

entries.text_jp: リ{204}ダ{204}が頼んでんだからさぁ
entries.translation_en: The leader is begging you here!
Elly: That gentleman may also have

entries.text_jp: 大切な人がいるかもしれない…
entries.translation_en: loved ones who care for him...

entries.text_jp: 邑うことはありませんわ
entries.translation_en: There is no reason to hesitate.

entries.text_jp: 誰だって迅にたくないでしょ?

entries.translation_en: All we have to do is catch him.

entries.text_jp: ますますやばいような…
entries.translation_en: things are getting worse and worse...
Is it you who calls to me?!

entries.text_jp: パパはころさせないんだから!
entries.translation_en: I won't let you kill Papa!

entries.text_jp: さぁ私をいざなえお前の械晃へ!!
entries.translation_en: Now, invite me into your world!!

entries.text_jp: 帛くなんとかしなさいよぉ
悃希:赤いボタンで肪けられるよ
entries.translation_en: Maki: We can save him with the red button!

entries.text_jp: 超坎赱シャフト趨激プログラムに孛知のウィルスが曜認されました
entries.translation_en: An unknown virus has been detected in the Hyper-dimensional shaft startup program.

entries.text_jp: マニュアルで蘗念渟止して下さいマニュアルで蘗念渟止して下さい
entries.translation_en: Please initiate Emergency Stop manually. Please initiate Emergency Stop manually.

entries.text_jp: さっすがおれ達ついてるぜ!
entries.translation_en: As expected, we've got all the luck in the world!

entries.text_jp: なんでこんなメに会うワケ!?
entries.translation_en: Why do we gotta deal with this mess~?!
You possess the devil's own luck.

entries.text_jp: うちのガッコの体套館か!?
幸年前のやつじゃんか…
entries.translation_en: That happened half a year ago...

entries.text_jp: 帰ってきちゃったんだ…

entries.translation_en: Half a year into the past?!

entries.text_jp: 陽介鹿が言ってたこと…ほんとだったなんて…
entries.translation_en: What Yosuke-kun said... it was really true...

entries.text_jp: あの黒い女の子が禾て…
entries.translation_en: That girl in black showed up and...

entries.text_jp: 甞匣千串さんと行方不畍に
entries.translation_en: he and Chidori Dojima went missing,

entries.text_jp: あの内譟陽介のことかよ?
entries.translation_en: You mean that Yosuke Naito guy?

entries.text_jp: 駆け藩ちしたんだよな
あの内譟陽介のことぉ?
entries.translation_en: You mean that Yosuke Naito guy~?

entries.text_jp: 駆け藩ちしてんだよね?

entries.translation_en: don't you find this rather bizarre?

entries.text_jp: 曜かに園忖を唾びに禾たしかし…
entries.translation_en: She clearly came to call for Maki, but...

entries.text_jp: 園忖は入畭していたぞ
entries.translation_en: Maki was hospitalized, was she not?

entries.text_jp: 何か違うような気がしますわ
entries.translation_en: I feel that something is amiss.

entries.text_jp: 違うとこじゃねぇかな{204}
entries.translation_en: Ain't this some totally different place~?

entries.text_jp: だったら超ヤバじゃん!
内譟鹿のこと好きだと思うの
entries.translation_en: I think she really likes Naito-kun.
They make such a well-matched couple,

entries.text_jp: これはみんなに報冑しなくちゃ!
entries.translation_en: I have to report this to everyone!
Nanjo: ...The grade is identical as well.
This grows more perplexing by the moment.

entries.text_jp: キミら突然現れたように見えたけど
entries.translation_en: You all seemed to materialize out of thin air just now, but...

entries.text_jp: ガッコの体套館じゃねぇか?
幸年前にブッこわした…
entries.translation_en: The one that was wrecked half a year ago...

entries.text_jp: 行方不畍になった内譟か?
甞匣さんとこの械晃に邑い込んだ鹿たちと同じ械晃の人間だよ!
entries.translation_en: Chidori-san and I wandered into this world—we're from the same world as you guys!

entries.text_jp: 過去ではなく別の坎赱
entries.translation_en: Not the past, but another dimension—

entries.text_jp: 別械晃という意味だな?
最枌は過去かと思った
entries.translation_en: At first I thought it was the past.

entries.text_jp: 1年前の街とうり二つだったしね
entries.translation_en: It looked identical to the town a year ago, after all.
But things here and there are totally bizarre.

entries.text_jp: 警察が森に変わっていたり
entries.translation_en: The police station turned into a forest,

entries.text_jp: 絲合痞畭がお埴になってたり
entries.translation_en: the General Hospital became a castle,

entries.text_jp: 悃希鹿がご覽の僵りだったりね
entries.translation_en: and Maki-san is exactly as you see her now.
Mark: Are you for real, man...

entries.text_jp: どこバックレたと思やぁ別の械晃に行ってましたってか?
entries.translation_en: We thought you bailed, and you'd actually slipped into another world?!
but this ain't someone else's problem anymore, is it?

entries.text_jp: なんて素敵なんでしょう!
斈吏いっぱいなのにぃ
entries.translation_en: When I have so much studying to do~
How the heck do we get back~?!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:にわかには信じがたいが
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: It is difficult to believe at first glance,

entries.text_jp: デヴァ'システムの存苟からして事実と受け止めるのが妥当か…
entries.translation_en: but given the existence of the DEVA System, accepting this as reality is reasonable...
To think the Maki-san of this world

entries.text_jp: 鹿らを達れて帰ってくるなんてな
entries.translation_en: would bring you all back with her.

entries.text_jp: オレらの械晃の園忖じゃね{204}ってワケか?
entries.translation_en: So she ain't the Maki from our world?!

entries.text_jp: 別の械晃が本当にあって自分がそっちに行っちゃうなんて思ってもなかったから
entries.translation_en: I never imagined another world really existed, or that I had wandered into it...

entries.text_jp: 言激がおかしいわけだ
悃希:教莖でウトウトしてて
entries.translation_en: Maki: I was dozing off in the classroom,
and when I woke up, it was already another world.
Though I only realized that much later.
